name: Jocasta Nu's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor
wookieepedia_title: Jocasta Nu's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor
description: In the days following the proclamation of the New Order, Jedi Master Jocasta Nu and astromech droid Beetoo flew a golden-plated Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor from her school to the Coruscant Underworld for Chief Librarian Nu to infiltrate the former Jedi Temple to retrieve a list of Force-sensitive children across the galaxy.
